steps.say: Each side has sixteen pawns. Click any of your pawns, then a square one step forward. Pawns never move sideways or backward.
A pawn can also step diagonally forward onto an empty square. That is how you slip past a wall of pawns.
steps.tip: The pawn on b3 can go straight on, or diagonally to c4.

steps.say: Only a diagonal step takes a piece. Move your pawn diagonally onto an enemy pawn to capture it.
steps.tip: Your pawn on b4 sits next to a black pawn on a5.

steps.say: The far rank is full of black pawns, so you break through by taking one. Your pawn on h7 can take the black pawn on g8 and win straight away.
steps.tip: The pawn on h7 steps diagonally forward onto the black pawn on g8.
steps.praise: You reached the far rank. That is the game.
